.devcontainer/docker-compose.yml:
services:
  devcontainer:
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: .devcontainer/dev.Dockerfile
    volumes:
      - ..:/workspace:cached
    depends_on:
      - sql
    networks:
      - dev
    extra_hosts:
      - "host.docker.internal:host-gateway"
    command: sleep infinity
    # ports: # let vscode handle port forwarding
    #   - "5173:5173"
    #   - "5165:5165"

  sql:
    image: mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/server:2022-latest
    user: root
    environment:
      ACCEPT_EULA: "Y"
      MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD: "LocalDev123!"
      MSSQL_PID: "Developer" # can also use "Express" but Developer has more features
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "/opt/mssql-tools/bin/sqlcmd", "-S", "localhost", "-U", "sa", "-P", "LocalDev123!", "-Q", "SELECT 1"]
      interval: 6s
      timeout: 4s
      retries: 30
    volumes:
      - sql-data:/var/opt/mssql
    networks:
      - dev
    ports:
      - "14333:1433"

volumes:
  sql-data:
  devcontainer-node-modules:
  devcontainer-dotnet-tools:

networks:
  dev:
    driver: bridge
server/.env.example:
# logging
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT="<otel_endpoint>"
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS="Authorization=ApiKey <apikey>"
OTEL_SERVICE_NAME="<service_name>"
OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES="deployment.environment=Development,service.namespace=<service_namespace>"

# auth
Auth__ClientId="<client-guid>"

# database
DB_CONNECTION="Server=localhost,14333;Database=AppDb;User ID=sa;Password=LocalDev123!;Encrypt=False;TrustServerCertificate=True;"

# smtp delivery
Smtp__Host="<smtp_host>"
Smtp__Port="587"
Smtp__Timeout="100000"
Smtp__UseSsl="true"
Smtp__Username="<smtp_username>"
Smtp__Password="<smtp_password>"
Smtp__FromEmail="no-reply@example.test"
Smtp__FromName="<app_display_name>"
Smtp__ReplyToEmail=""
Smtp__BccEmail=""

# notification defaults
Notification__BaseUrl="http://localhost:5173"
Notification__DefaultAppName="<app_display_name>"
Notification__DefaultButtonText="Open the application"
